conventions.cell: the vacuum-gated MOND switch of L359: MOND on where x~ >= x_c0 E(z)^(2p); written p{p:g}_x{x_c0:.1f}. 'none' = the stage runs without that switch (unswitched/isolated phantom, or no phantom at all); 'per-row' = the stage scans cells and each row carries its own. Carrier gates (L357 p_v/x_v0, L372 P_GATE, L373 P_G/P_U, AT y_v0/q) are carrier fields, never the cell.
conventions.switch_dependent: true when the stage's number would change with the switch cell (phantom felt by baryons, lensing maps, shear bound, KiDS edge, flagship edge). Stages marked false are excluded from cell comparisons.

kernels.nu_mono: L340 monotone envelope of nu_RAR (L352 nu_vec / L370 nu_mono / L355 nu_mono_arr)
kernels.mu_exp: closure-spec exponential law (DE1 working tree only)

operators.global_baryon_masked: L377 phantom(): g_N from ALL baryons (periodic Poisson), response (nu-1) g_N masked by the switch cells, curl-free projection; baryons feel it everywhere
operators.global_total_matter_smooth: L359/L347 forest PM: g_N from ALL matter, tanh switch ramp
operators.region_fft: L370 phantom_felt(): label connected switch regions, g_w from each region's OWN baryons (periodic FFT), response masked to the region, projected; baryons feel only their region's phantom
operators.region_dirichlet: L363 region_phantom(): masked Poisson with w = 0 off the region (Dirichlet), source = bound baryons in the region
operators.spherical_compensated: L352 fit_model/fit_comb: 1-D isolated lens phantom, Gauss-compensated at the switch edge
operators.spherical_isolated: 1-D isolated kernel without a switch edge (L321/L354 X-COP, L355 KiDS web-blind, L320 flagship)
